Awesome Neovim

Collections of awesome Neovim plugins. Mostly targeting Neovim specific features.

Neovim is a Vim-based text editor engineered for extensibility and usability, to encourage new applications and contributions.

Wishlist

Have a problem a plugin can solve? Add it to the nvim-lua wishliststars155.

UI

Neovim supports a wide variety of UI's.

  • CosmicNvim/cosmic-uistars60 - Cosmic-UI is a simple wrapper around specific vim functionality. Built in order to provide a quick and easy way to create a Cosmic UI experience with Neovim!
  • yatli/fvimstars903 - Cross platform Neovim front-end UI, built with F# + Avalonia.
  • smolck/uivonimstars426 - Goal: Feature-rich cross-platform GUI that leverages the latest Neovim features.
  • qvacua/vimrstars5.7k - Neovim GUI for macOS in Swift.
  • vhakulinen/gnvimstars1.5k - GUI for Neovim, without any web bloat.
  • Kethku/neovidestars6.7k - No Nonsense Neovim Client in Rust.
  • beeender/glrnvimstars215 - A terminal wrapper that launches Neovim inside of alacritty.
  • akiyosi/goneovimstars1.6k - Neovim GUI written in Golang, using a Golang qt backend.
  • DinVim - DinVim for macOS is a safe and secure working macOS sandbox environment that provide true macOS experience for Vim users.
  • RMichelsen/Nvystars150 - A Neovim client in C++.
  • asvetliakov/vscode-neovimstars2.8k - Neovim integration for Visual Studio Code.
  • equalsraf/neovim-qtstars1.3k - Neovim client library and GUI, in Qt5.
  • lunixbochs/actualvimstars1.5k - Sublime Text 3 input mode using Neovim.
  • vv-vim/vvstars184 - Neovim client for macOS. A pure, fast, minimalistic Vim experience with good macOS integration. Optimized for speed and nice font rendering.
  • jebberjeb/javafx-neovimpanestars37 - A JavaFX text pane, backed by Neovim, created with Clojure.
  • rohit-px2/nvuistars1.5k - A modern frontend for Neovim.
  • Lyude/neovim-gtkstars40 - A GTK3+ client written in Rust, ressembling a lot the original vim-gtk3 with ligatures support.

Plugin

Plugin Manager

  • wbthomason/packer.nvimstars2.6k - A use-package inspired plugin manager for Neovim. Uses native packages, supports Luarocks dependencies, written in Lua, allows for expressive config.
  • savq/paq-nvimstars424 - Neovim package manager written in Lua.
  • NTBBloodbath/cheovimstars152 - Neovim configuration switcher written in Lua. Inspired by chemacs.

LSP

(requires Neovim 0.5)

  • neovim/nvim-lspconfigstars4.3k - Quickstart configurations for the Neovim LSP client.

  • onsails/diaglist.nvimstars96 - Live render workspace diagnostics in quickfix, buffer diagnostics in loclist.

  • ray-x/lsp_signature.nvimstars865 - Lsp signature hint when you type.

  • jubnzv/virtual-types.nvimstars147 - Neovim plugin that shows type annotations as virtual text.
  • jose-elias-alvarez/nvim-lsp-ts-utilsstars400 - Utilities to improve the TypeScript development experience for Neovim's built-in LSP client.
  • ray-x/navigator.luastars626 - Learn existing code quickly and navigate code like a breeze. A swiss army knife makes exploring LSP and 🌲Treesitter symbols a piece of 🍰.

  • simrat39/rust-tools.nvimstars757 - Tools for better development in rust using Neovim's builtin LSP.

  • jose-elias-alvarez/null-lsstars1.2k - Use Neovim as a language server to inject LSP diagnostics, code actions, and more via Lua.
  • jakewvincent/texmagic.nvimstars19 - Enhance the lspconfig settings for Texlab by defining any number of custom LaTeX build engines and selecting them with magic comments.
  • nanotee/nvim-lsp-basicsstars15 - Basic wrappers for LSP features.
  • weilbith/nvim-code-action-menustars304 - A floating pop-up menu for code actions to show code action information and a diff preview.
  • mfussenegger/nvim-lintstars313 - An asynchronous linter plugin for Neovim (>= 0.5) complementary to the built-in Language Server Protocol support.
  • b0o/SchemaStore.nvimstars186 - A Neovim Lua plugin providing access to the SchemaStorestars1.7k catalog.
  • ldelossa/litee.nvimstars215 - Neovim's missing IDE features.
  • fidget.nvimstars395 - Standalone UI for nvim-lsp progress.
  • git.sr.ht/~whynothugo/lsp_lines.nvim - A Neovim plugin that renders diagnostics using virtual lines on top of the real line of code.
  • scalameta/nvim-metalsstars170 - Neovim plugin for Metals, the Scala language server, using Neovim's builtin LSP.

Colorscheme

Tree-sitter Supported Colorscheme

Tree-sitter is a new system coming in Neovim 0.5 that incrementally parses your code into a tree that works, even with errors in your syntax. These colorschemes have specifically set colors for Tree-sitter highlight groups. Vim colorschemes will work with the new groups out of the box.

  • rafamadriz/neonstars76 - Customizable colorscheme with excellent italic and bold support, dark and light variants. Made to work and look good with Tree-sitter.
  • tomasiser/vim-code-darkstars725 - A dark color scheme heavily inspired by the look of the Dark+ scheme of Visual Studio Code.

  • beauwilliams/focus.nvimstars323 - Auto-Focusing and Auto-Resizing Splits/Windows for Neovim written in Lua! Vim splits on steroids.
  • luukvbaal/stabilize.nvimstars231 - Stabilized window content on window open/close events.

External

These tools are used externally to Neovim to enhance the experience.

Version Manager

  • NTBBloodbath/nvenvstars29 - A lightweight and blazing fast Neovim version manager.
  • shohi/nevastars10 - A Neovim version manager written in Lua.

Boilerplate

  • gennaro-tedesco/boilitstars37 - Create boilerplate structure for Neovim plugins.

Vim

  • Vimawesome - Showcases various plugins for vim and has a neovim tag for other plugins targeting Neovim.
  • awesome-vimstars1.6k - Short list of vim plugins and helpful guides.

Resource

  • Neovimcraft - A site dedicated to searching for Neovim specific plugins and guides for building plugins in Lua.
